steps: Place 2 FOGO Firestarters inside a Blazaball and place it on the charcoal grate. Use your grill torch to light them. Once burning, fill your grill with FOGO Super Premium Charcoal until just below the conveggtor. Add 2-3 smoking chunks and add the conveggtor and cooking grate. Prepare the grill for indirect cooking at 250°F.
Pat the Chuck Roast dry and trim off any extra fat. Season it with the Notorious P.I.G. BBQ Rub and a sprinkling of Jacobsens salt. Set the meat aside.

Put all of the chopped onions, minced garlic and chopped peppers in the Dutch Oven and coat with the chili powder. Place the pot, uncovered in the center of the cooking grate and place the rack over the opening. Put the Chuck Roast on the grate over the pot of vegetables and smoke for one hour.

After one hour, place all of the other ingredients in the Dutch Oven. Stir to combine everything well. Now take the Chuck Roast and put it down into the pot. The juices etc. should just about cover the meat. Place the lid on the pot, close the dome and cook for 2-3 more hours, until the meat will easily shred.

Once you have reached this point, remove the meat from the chili and shred it. You'll want to put on a pair of cotton gloves covered with rubber gloves to protect your hands from the heat. Put all of the shredded beef back into the chili and stir well.
